name: Kibble Clock
tagline: A feeding clock that swings a printed flap open at 8 am and 7 pm and shows the time and the next feed

behaviour.summary: Shows the time (from the internet over the home Wi-Fi) and the next and last feed. At 08:00 and 19:00 it shows a feeding reminder and swings the printed flap open for 3 seconds, then closes it. Press the button to clear the reminder. The flap fits your own food chute: portion size is a physical check, not promised, and it does not weigh the bowl.

safety.notes: One MG90S servo on the only 5 V port (no LED light). The printed flap is not food-safe certified; it only swings in front of your own food chute. Portion size is not measured. Keep fingers clear of the flap. Not for children.
